elaine-marketing: T-72 check-in — final sync on the launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar slot, inbound lead routing, and changelog/docs links. Quick asks: when do we freeze the changelog? where do docs point? webinar speaker + slide link? how are leads routed? I'll consolidate into a checklist.

mike-eng: Changelog freeze -> we'll cut and lock the release branch tomorrow at 12:00 PT. After that only doc fixes or critical patches.

alex-docs: Docs staging link ready: https://staging.docs.redwood.com/release/rc-2026-03-24
Final URL will be https://docs.redwood.com/release/rc-2026-03-24 — I'll update the migration note and add the short FAQ.

alex-docs: Changelog snippet (will paste into release notes)
```
v2026.03.24 — release
- Optimized batching paths for GPT-like models (20% lower p99 latency)
- New routing policy: region-aware fallback
- Console: per-route token breakdown
```

samira-growth: Webinar locked — Fri 10:00 AM PT. Speaker confirmed: @sarah-product. Deck in Drive: https://drive.google.com/launch-deck
Landing page needs CTA and UTM parameters: ?utm_source=announce&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rc_march

jamal-sales: For inbound routing — please tag all post-launch form submissions with source=launch_march and topic=(webinar|benchmarks). We'll route to 'Launch - March' queue in Salesforce. Pardot team — confirm field mappings.

sarah-product: I'll own the benchmark narrative: 3 bullets (latency, throughput/cost, real-world customer example). Need final numbers from infra by EOD today.

mike-eng: Perf numbers: p50=45ms, p95=220ms, p99=420ms (private deployment, typical 2048 token run). We'll export CSV and sedate the graphs for the blog.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-24T14:00:00Z -> 2h window. Auto-fallback on error rate > 2% or latency > 2x baseline. Canary will run on dedicated pool: dp-rc-march.

elaine-marketing: Action items I have: 1) Draft announcement + benchmark blurb (I'll share by 9am PT tomorrow). 2) Confirm docs URL and attach to changelog. 3) Update webinar landing with UTMs. 4) Confirm SFDC routing (jamal please confirm). 5) Prepare social copy variations for A/B test.

jamal-sales: Confirmed — I'll set the routing and create the 'Launch - March' queue now and share mapping by EOD.

alex-docs: Will post final docs URL into this thread when live.

elaine-marketing: Thanks all — tagging this thread as the single source for launch-ready links. :rocket:
